summary: P0 Per-Slide Narration Control & Cost Estimation Testing - All 15 backend tests PASSED. Frontend components verified for proper structure and data-testid attributes.

minor.issue: Required backend restart to register route (hot reload didn't pick up endpoint initially)

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Cost calculation uses correct ElevenLabs Starter pricing ($5/30,000 chars = $0.000167/char)
GOOD: Per-slide narration toggle persists to session config.narrationSlides as {slideIndex: boolean} map
GOOD: Cost estimate endpoint reads narrationSlides from config and calculates per-slide costs from storyboard.slides[i].narrationScript
GOOD: Frontend StoryboardPanel correctly displays quota percentage (chars/30000 * 100) and progress bar
GOOD: handleApprove function calls save-narration-config before proceeding to media config step

success_rate.frontend: Verified - Component structure correct with all required data-testid attributes

seed_data_creation: Test sessions created/cleaned up automatically by test fixtures (TEST_narration_* prefix)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-slide narration control and cost estimation feature verified. Key endpoints: POST /api/agent/sessions/{id}/save-narration-config (saves narrationSlides map, voiceId, enabled status), POST /api/agent/sessions/{id}/cost-estimate (returns costs including narration based on per-slide character counts). Frontend StoryboardPanel at step 4 has global toggle, voice selector, per-slide checkboxes, select all/deselect all, cost summary with quota percentage. ElevenLabs voices available at GET /api/elevenlabs/voices.

save-narration-config endpoint.details: Returns 200 with enabledSlides count, persists config to session, 404 for invalid session

cost-estimate endpoint.details: Returns full estimate structure, calculates narration cost when enabled, uses $5/30k chars pricing, returns 0 when disabled

elevenlabs voices endpoint.details: Returns voice list with voice_id and name fields

cost calculation formulas.details: Cost per char ($0.000167), sample calculations (100-30000 chars), quota percentage verified

StoryboardPanel component.details: Has data-testid attributes for: storyboard-panel, storyboard-narration-global-toggle, storyboard-voice-*, narration-slide-row-*, narration-select-all, narration-deselect-all, narration-cost-summary, narration-total-cost, approve-storyboard-btn

Cost display.details: Shows total cost ($X.XXXX), total characters, Starter plan quota percentage with progress bar

Integration.details: handleApprove calls save-narration-config API before proceeding
